name: vscode-metrics-tracker
description: Tracks editing metrics (written text, removed text, cursor positions) and writes them to a local file.

metricsTracker.outputFile.description: Output file for metrics events. Relative paths resolve from the first workspace folder.

metricsTracker.captureRawText.description: When true, inserted and removed text are recorded in full.

metricsTracker.captureCursorSelections.description: When true, cursor and selection movement is recorded.

metricsTracker.excludeOutputFileFromTrac.description: When true, the configured metrics output file is excluded from tracking to prevent recursive logging.

metricsTracker.maxEvents.description: Maximum number of recent events persisted to the metrics file. Older events are discarded.

metricsTracker.writerFlushIntervalMs.description: How often buffered metrics are flushed to disk.

metricsTracker.textChangeDebounceMs.description: Text changes are aggregated and logged once typing pauses for this many milliseconds.

metricsTracker.cursorDebounceMs.description: Cursor/selection changes are logged after this idle period to avoid high-frequency noise.

metricsTracker.maxRawTextChars.description: Maximum inserted/removed raw text characters stored per aggregated text-change event.
